title: Family exchange
objectives: discuss family structure in cultural exchange contexts

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Family exchange.
Welcome to today's lesson: Family exchange! Today we will practice how to discuss family structure in cultural exchange contexts.

elements.content: discuss family structure in cultural exchange contexts; use possessive adjectives and 's accurately

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: mother, father, brother, sister, husband, wife

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Where does the host family live in the reading passage?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: In my family exchange, my host brother and sister live in London with their cousin.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
My host family in England is very nice. My host mother and father have two children and an aunt.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Describe your host or exchange family structure to your partner.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: discuss family structure in cultural exchange contexts, use possessive adjectives and 's accurately.
